name: Mirroring supporting databases behind firewall
description: Database Mirroring in Fabric provides an easy experience to avoid complex ETL and reflect your entire database in Microsoft Fabric. Using either the virtual network data gateway or the on-premises data gateway, you can now replicate data from database that are on-premise or behind a firewall. The data gateway facilitates secure connections to your source databases through a private endpoint or from a specific private network.
